messages:
Maria Chen: kicking off prod rollout for release v2.8.0 — change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. I’ll monitor canaries. :rocket:
ci-bot: deploy pipeline started for release v2.8.0 (build 20260320.124) -> rolling canary pods.
deploy-bot: canary 1/5 deployed to prod-us-west1. health checks passing.
Tom Bowers: seeing a spike in 502s hitting /v1/embeddings on canary-2, logs show `ERROR: missing API key` around tokenization step.
Priya Singh: hmm staging had no errors. quick check: in staging the secret is `embedding_api_key` (base64 key: `Z...`). In prod the app expects `EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY`. Suspect key name mismatch. :warning:
Alex Li: confirmed. ran `kubectl -n prod get secret embeddings -o yaml` — key present is `embedding_api_key` but app env expects `EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY`. prod manifest reads `valueFrom: secretKeyRef: key: EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY`. That's the drift.
Dave R.: Terraform secret resource name also differs from the k8s secret we have in prod. Looks like a rename slipped through during infra refactor last quarter.
Maria Chen: pause the rollout. @deploy-bot cancel further canary promotions. We should rollback canary -> stable if needed.
deploy-bot: pausing rollout. stopping canary promotions.
Tom Bowers: recommending rollback to v2.7.9 (last known-good) while infra fixes secret mapping — low blast radius.
Priya Singh: I can push a quick patch to create a compat key `EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY` in prod by copying the existing secret value, then re-run canaries. But that’s a hotfix; opsec check: will need approvals for secret copy.
Alex Li: agree with rollback first. Hotfix after rollback with audit log. Also pin the release to `v2.7.9` in the deploy manifest to avoid automatic retries.
Maria Chen: rolling back to v2.7.9 now. @ci-bot run rollback job and pin release in deployment config. Update release notes to mention rollback and follow-up.
ci-bot: rollback job started -> rolling back to v2.7.9.
deploy-bot: rollback completed: services back to v2.7.9, all health checks passing.
Maria Chen: thanks. reopening issue ENG-4589 (prod-config-parity) and assigning to infra-team + Priya for the hotfix. Please add short postmortem after resolution.
Priya Singh: will create the compat secret and run a smoke test in prod, then open PR to standardize key name in terraform. Also will add a pre-deploy check to the release pipeline to verify required secret keys exist and match expected names.
Alex Li: for next release let's add a gating step that runs `kubectl -n $NS get secret $NAME -o jsonpath='{.data}' | jq keys` and compare against expected keys in the release manifest. Failing the check should block promotion.
Dave R.: noted — infra will also run a terraform state reconcile job weekly to catch drift.
Maria Chen: update release notes: "v2.8.0 rollout paused and rolled back due to secret key name drift between staging and prod; rollback to v2.7.9. Follow-up ENG-4589 created; preflight checks to be added."
Tom Bowers: waving flag for new checklist item: secret key name parity between envs. :white_flag:
Priya Singh: will follow up with compliance about copying secret values for the hotfix and attach audit logs.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone — re-schedule the change window if needed once hotfix is validated.
ci-bot: marking pipeline build 20260320.124 as rolled back.
